blocks.text: Masail ki solvability (hal ho sakne ki salahiyat) aur complexity (pecheedgi, yani hal mein kitna waqt aur memory lagti hai) samajhna computer science ka bunyadi tasawwur hai. Is se hum tay karte hain ke koi masla algorithm se hal ho sakta hai ya nahi, aur agar ho sakta hai to kitni efficiency se. Is hisse mein solvable aur unsolvable masail, aur tractable aur intractable masail ka farq dekha jayega, jo computational complexity samajhne ki bunyad hai.

blocks.prompt: Yeh hissa kisi masle ke baare mein kaunse do sawal poochta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kya koi algorithm ise hal kar sakta hai (solvability)? Aur agar haan, to kitni efficiency se (complexity)?

items: Pehle poochein: masla hal ho sakta hai? Phir: kitni efficiency se? (solvable/unsolvable, tractable/intractable)
